text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I decide to take a stroll
through town.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Urrrgh...

And along the way, I happen across a very
familiar figure, shaking in
an equally
familiar way. Could she be crying?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I-I'm sorry for loitering! I'll move
along right—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait... Trainer? Ahhh, thank
goodness it's just you! H-hello!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I, ummm... I came out to buy some
clothes, but... All these stores are so
stylish...
Am I really allowed to just walk
in?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-no, of course not! Someone like me
could never wear such pretty things!
Th-the only thing that suits me is that
plastic bag over there!
I'll just wear that!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! B-but I need new clothes... All my
others got destroyed...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I was going through my clothes to see
what I don't wear anymore...
and before I
knew it, all my clothes were torn to
shreds...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-it's my fault,
really... I shouldn't have had
the window open...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just trying to bring some fresh
air
into the room! I never
expected my
blouses and skirts to... to... Ooohhh...

I... don't think I need to know any
more. In summary, it sounds like
Doto needs new
clothes, but she's too scared to enter the
shops alone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way!

A little harsh,
but at least she told it to me
straight...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait!
I-i-it's not that I don't want to go
shopping with you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's just... N-never mind! I'm fine! I...
I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll just wear plastic bags for the rest
of my
liiiife!

She dashes off, but thanks to her long
skirt, she can't run as fast as
usual. I might
actually be able to catch up to her!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... Wh-why?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Why are you following me?!
Finally, we reach the end of our chase...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Wh-why do you keep chasing me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep! I-I'm sorry! I really am!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but I don't want to bother you! I mean,
today's supposed to be your
day off!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-and if I take up your time even on your
day off... That would make
me the worst of
the worst!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You already have to deal with me and my
blunders on an almost daily
basis...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to tire you out any more
than I
already do... You need a
break... away
from me...

Setting aside the self-deprecating way she
expresses it, Meisho Doto
is clearly trying
to be considerate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was running away... But then
you had to go and chase
after me! I'm
telling you, I'll cause you trouble!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Y-you do?! Wh-what?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait... Is this... Trainer... Are you...
into
that sort of thing?

I explain that, as her trainer, it's only
natural that she takes up a lot of
my time.
In fact, I want her to trust me—to lean on
me more.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-uh... If I were to l-l-lean on you...
I'd
probably crush you...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The minute we lock arms, I'd probably trip
and drag you down with
me... Oooh,
there'd be bits and pieces everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I... Um... Thank you?
She seems a bit confused, but at least now she knows that she can ask me for help when needed. It's up to her whether she takes me up on that or not.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... R-right!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... Then, uh... shall we?

The perpetually perplexed Meisho Doto
and I make our way back to
the streets,
ready to shop...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... We're closed for today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Already?! W-we would've made it in time
if I hadn't run away... I'm
sorry...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-maybe I really am... destined to wear
plastic bags...

I comfort the crestfallen Meisho Doto.
Perhaps someday, she'll ask me for help of
her own will, but until then,
I'll just have to
keep offering...
